message.content: In the discussion regarding the garden renovation, Turalyon initially suggested adding a small seating area to the plans, emphasizing its importance for relaxation and enjoyment of the garden. Following this suggestion, Arthas Menethil supported the idea, stating that "a nice spot to enjoy the flowers and herbs would be amazing." This indicates that Turalyon and Arthas Menethil both contributed feedback and suggestions related to enhancing the garden's comfort and appeal. There is no mention of Illidan Stormrage complaining about the construction noise prior to or after these discussions. Instead, Illidan Stormrage expressed interest in hearing about noise control measures and shared ideas about keeping residents informed about any particularly noisy work. Therefore, based on the information provided, there is no evidence that Turalyon announced the construction updates and feedback from residents after Illidan Stormrage complained about the construction noise.
